title: Theories
content: Hi, I just joined! A little about me. I have visited mall world many times. Mostly as a child, a little less as a teen and then had a few years where I haven’t been there. Back in I believe 2022 I visited there again (not purposely) and now 3 years later I haven’t been there again(that I know of. As I get older I remember less of my dreams). I’m 25 now. Anyways on to what this post is originally about. I’m sure someone has asked this before. What are your theories on why so many people feel uneasy in mall world and why do others have the best time? For me it’s always so eerie (besides the dreams where I fly) and I end up feeling like everything is wrong. Which one are you and what are your thoughts on the matter?
